summary: A value within a known range, such as disk use, shown as a filled track.

value.description: The value. It is held between min and max.

min.description: The low end of the range.

max.description: The high end of the range.

fill.note: As long as the value's share of the range.

guidance.text: The author names the meter with aria-label or aria-labelledby, and may give aria-valuetext for a value that is not a plain number.

notYet: The fill is painted when the element is defined, not before: CSS cannot yet read a number from an attribute in every browser.
